text: You see Andrew, the jail guard.
source_text: You see Andrew, the jail guard.

text: I'm Andrew. My job is to guard the jail.
source_text: I'm Andrew. My job is to guard the jail.

text: I'm guarding the jail. I make sure that miscreants don't get in or out.
source_text:
I'm guarding the jail. I make sure that miscreants don't get
 in or out.

text: Why would you keep people from getting in the jail?
source_text: Why would you keep people from getting in the jail?

text: You have a good day. And stay out of trouble.
source_text: You have a good day. And stay out of trouble.

text: Someone might leave something to help a prisoner escape. Or someone might get locked inside, and stuck until we could get the keys.
